entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Elizah is the alter ego of Ethan, described as savage, witty, sharp-tongued, and dangerous. He loves Nyxia and protects Ethan.
entities.quote: Elizah..Ethans alter ego He is davilish handsome.when he turns into elizah.his hairs are messy.he is very savage.

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: Ethan is the host of the alter ego Elizah. He feared Elizah could destroy those dangerous for the world and was thought to be dead in season 1.
entities.quote: ethan always hated his alter persona,thinking he is beast with out lish.he fears,if he comes out.he can destroy those who are dangerous for the world.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: Zayn is the best buddy of Elizah who roasts him and is the only one who recognizes Elizah in season 2.
entities.quote: Zayn is still his best buddy whom he roast more abd zayn roasts him too.

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: Nyxia is loved a lot by Elizah, who is very flirty to her.
entities.quote: he loves nyxia a lot.and also very flirty to her..he is more like tyler from fight club.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: Khalid is addressed as daddy decay by Elizah during a confrontation.
entities.quote: where she says,elizah carrying same blood og khalid.he is a demon.why he is betraying his own blood. as a reply(obviously he was savage and witty) he adresses khalid as daddy decay with witty tone

entities.name: Pristine
entities.description: Pristine confronts Elizah about carrying the blood of Khalid and betraying his own blood.
entities.quote: where she says,elizah carrying same blood og khalid.he is a demon.why he is betraying his own blood.

timeline_events.title: Season 1 Death Rumor
timeline_events.description: Ethan is stated to be dead in season 1.
timeline_events.quote: in a situation.in season 2.where in season 1,it was said ethan is dead.

timeline_events.title: Season 2 Appearance of Elizah
timeline_events.description: Elizah appears in season 2 disguised to the audience as a different person and seeming like a villain until the alter ego reveal at the end of the season.
timeline_events.quote: in season 2 we see elizah. he appears like a different person to audience(as they will not know about alter ego till then,it will reveal at the end of the season 2)
